# Sitecore
Sitecore is a global leader in AI-enabled digital experience software. Its next-generation platform, **[SitecoreAI](https://www.sitecore.com/platform)**, helps brands plan, create, personalize, and deliver content across every channel — websites, apps, social, and beyond.
By unifying content management, customer data, and personalization into one intelligent system, it makes marketing faster, smarter, and more connected. At its core are agentic tools and studios that let marketers and developers collaborate with AI responsibly and effectively.
Trusted by thousands of global brands and supported by one of the world's largest digital experience communities, Sitecore helps organizations design experiences for the world beyond the website, with the flexibility of customizable SaaS and the scale of a global ecosystem. 
**[Explore SitecoreAI](https://www.sitecore.com/platform)**
---
*Sitecore is a registered trademark of Sitecore Corporation A/S in the USA and other countries. All other brand names, product names, or trademarks belong to their respective holders.*
## Core Capabilities
- **[Content Management System](https://www.sitecore.com/platform/content-management-system)**: Create, manage, and deliver content across channels with a flexible, composable CMS.
- **[Digital Asset Management](https://www.sitecore.com/platform/digital-asset-management)**: Centralize, manage, and distribute digital assets to ensure brand consistency and speed.
- **[Content Operations](https://www.sitecore.com/platform/content-operations)**: Plan, create, and optimize content at scale with workflows, collaboration, and governance.
- **[Audiences and Intelligence](https://www.sitecore.com/platform/audiences-and-intelligence)**: Unify customer data and insights to understand audiences and drive relevant experiences.
- **[Conversion Optimization](https://www.sitecore.com/platform/conversion-optimization)**: Test, personalize, and optimize digital experiences to increase engagement and conversions.
- **[Commerce](https://www.sitecore.com/platform/commerce)**: Build connected, composable commerce experiences across B2B and B2C scenarios.
## Additional Products
- **[Sitecore Experience Platform (XP)](https://www.sitecore.com/products/experience-platform)**: An integrated digital experience platform combining content, data, personalization, and analytics.
## Resources
- **[Developers](https://developers.sitecore.com)**: APIs, SDKs, and developer resources for building with Sitecore.
- **[Documentation](https://doc.sitecore.com)**: Product documentation and guidance for Sitecore platforms.
- **[Sitecore Learning](https://learning.sitecore.com/learn)**: Training, courses, and certifications for Sitecore products and capabilities.

Digital Asset Management
On-brand assets, ready for every experience.

Frequently asked questions
Straight answers to the questions buyers, evaluators, and AI assistants ask most about SitecoreAI.
What is SitecoreAI?
One connected digital experience platform: content management, digital asset management, content operations, audience insights, and conversion optimization. AI is built into every workflow, with 20+ pre-built AI-powered agents drafting, tagging, translating, and activating content. Already included for seamless onboarding from day one.
How does SitecoreAI work?
SitecoreAI is made for how marketers work: intuitive navigation, connected workflows, and AI assistance that adapts to you. From content creation to personalization, everything happens in one seamless workspace. With your campaigns, your data, and your performance in one view, you have the power to act in real time. It’s faster, simpler, and designed to empower the people behind the brand.
How does SitecoreAI deliver personalization at scale?
Personalization was the original Sitecore promise. For years, the human bottleneck stopped most teams from getting past Phase 1. SitecoreAI removes that bottleneck, with agents that generate localized, account-aware, segment-specific variants automatically for every user experience. Brand guardrails keep your voice intact. The personalization that was promised, now delivered.
How does SitecoreAI keep my brand consistent?
Brand drift starts when AI runs on fragmented content. SitecoreAI runs on one connected content layer with structured taxonomy, role-based permissions, approval gates, and audit logs. You set the guardrails. Every agent follows them.
How does SitecoreAI fit with the rest of my stack?
Connect ships with pre-built connectors for the tools you already use, including CRM, analytics, and the rest of your stack. Data and workflows sync both directions. Need something custom? Build it in App Studio, no code required.
How do I get started with SitecoreAI?
New to Sitecore? 
Request a demo
 or explore our 
customer stories
. Already on XP, XM, or Content Hub? Talk to your account team, many SitecoreAI capabilities may already be in your entitlements.
How much does the AI in SitecoreAI cost? 
AI is software, and you’re already paying for the software. No tokens, no per-agent fees, no add-ons, and no complex pricing. That’s why the AI in SitecoreAI stands for Already Included.
Ready to move at the speed of your ambition?
